newsitem.title: USA: Kerkorian withdraws Chrysler, MGM share donation.
newsitem.headline: Kerkorian withdraws Chrysler, MGM share donation.

text.p: Investor Kirk Kerkorian said Friday he is withdrawing a planned donation of 20 million common Chrysler Corp shares and two million MGM Grand Inc common shares to a California foundation.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Kerkorian said the request had been withdrawn because his Tracinda Corp learned a requested favorable tax ruling will not be approved by the Internal Revenue Service.

As a result of the failure to obtain the tax ruling, the proposed donation to the Lincy Foundation will not be made, the filing said. The donation first announced in 1995 was to have begun in November 1997.
However, Tracinda will made comparable gifts to charitable organizations directly in the form of shares of Chrysler common, MGM Grand common, other securities or cash.

Such donations may be made at times different from the times proposed donations to the Lincy Foundation were to have been made. The donations beginning in November 1997 were to have been made in three annual installments.

According to the filing, one condition for the 22 million combined share donation to the California non-profit public benefit board formed by Tracinda in 1989 was a favorable tax ruling by the IRS relating to the proposed gift.
To date, Tracinda has donated $38,500,288 in stock and cash to 30 charitable organizations.
Kerkorian holds a 13.73 percent stake in Chrysler Corp or 96,496,992 common shares and a 61.6 percent stake in MGM Grand or 35,621,265 common shares.
